title: These US labs risk imminent closure after Trump cuts
paragraphs: Even when the first four of his five federal grants were cancelled in February, Jeremy Springman still had hope. The social-science research that he co-leads at the University of Pennsylvania in Philadelphia had enough funding from a largeUS Department of Defense projectto tide him over for two more years. He checked in with his defence-department programme officer, who reassured him that the remaining grant would be safe.
title_original: These US labs risk imminent closure after Trump cuts
